title: Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2609.37362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. translated_title: 一次预训练，处处路由：迈向大语言模型路由的基础模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）路由旨在将每个查询分配给异构候选池中最合适的模型，从而改善LLM推理的质量-效率权衡。现有路由器通常通过局部拟合来学习：即针对特定的查询工作负载和候选池进行优化，并且随着路由环境的变化，往往需要额外的监督或重新训练。我们探讨是否可以从基础模型的视角来处理LLM路由问题，即学习一种可复用的路由能力，使其能够泛化到不同的任务、候选模型和部署条件。为此，我们提出了RouteFM，它学习从行为上下文中刻画匿名候选模型，并推断其针对特定目标的能力，而不是将路由决策绑定到固定的模型身份或单一环境上。通过在异构路由环境中进行情景式预训练，这种能力……
tldr: 提出了RouteFM——一个面向LLM路由的基础模型，通过在异构路由环境中的情景式预训练，学习从行为上下文刻画匿名候选模型的能力，从而获得可跨任务、候选模型和部署条件泛化的可复用路由能力，摆脱了传统路由器需要针对特定环境局部拟合和反复重新训练的局限。
